description: Stop mirroring a Forge vault (DELETE /forge/vaults/{vault_id}/mirrors). Requires vault_id. With account_address only that account's mirror is revoked (404 if it has no active mirror); without it every active mirror you hold on that vault is revoked. The mirror row is kept with status revoked and a revoked_at time; later plans for that vault are refused until you consent again. Needs your agent key (X-NW-User-Key).

account_address.description: Optional: revoke just this account's mirror

name: forge_mirror_revoke
title: Revoke a Forge mirror
